I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store is Pine Crossing.

She posted it in #central-team herself on June 9. Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead of being booked. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store's login.

Nothing later in the channel says it was fixed, and I couldn't find any Marrow Agrisupply account files I could open. So I can't confirm the issue is resolved before she updates the account sheet. I only used #central-team, which she's a member of.
